title: API Console never renders the Storage group on any host — the catalog key is `storage` while `/discovery` names the slot `file-storage`, so the fail-closed branch hides 3 endpoints
body:
## Symptom

The API Console page (`developer:api-console`, Studio → Developer → API Console) renders **no Storage group at all — on any host**, whether or not a storage service is registered and healthy.

Three endpoints are consequently unreachable from that page:

| method | path | description |
|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/v1/storage/upload` | Upload file (multipart/form-data) |
| GET | `/api/v1/storage/:fileId` | Download file |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/storage/:fileId` | Delete file |

**Expected:** the Storage group renders wherever the storage slot is filled and usable, exactly like the other service-gated groups (the rest of the item passed — the tree matched `/discovery` 10/10 and executed real 200/404/400 calls).

## Root cause

Located, and it is a **name mismatch across the two sides of one lookup**:

- the console's catalog declares the group under the key **`storage`** (objectui `apps/console/src/pages/developer/hooks/useApiDiscovery.ts`, `SERVICE_ENDPOINT_CATALOG`);
- `/discovery` reports the service under its canonical slot name **`file-storage`** (`packages/spec/src/system/core-services.zod.ts` lists `'file-storage'` as the storage-driver slot, mapped to `@objectstack/service-storage`);
- the render loop looks the catalog key up directly in the discovery payload — `const serviceInfo = discoveredServices[serviceName]` — so it always misses, and the very next line is the **fail-closed** branch: `const usable = serviceInfo ? isServiceUsable(serviceInfo) : false;` with the comment *"Services absent from discovery keep the historical fail-closed behavior of this page: no entry → no endpoint group."*

The fail-closed posture is correct and deliberate (ADR-0076 D12); it is the key that is wrong. The framework side is the canonical one here — `file-storage` is the declared slot name — so the fix belongs to the **console catalog key**, not to `/discovery`.

**Cross-repo:** the fix lands in **objectui** (`apps/console/src/pages/developer/hooks/useApiDiscovery.ts`), not in this repo — which is why this card carries no `domain:*` lane. Still present on objectui `origin/main` as of 2026-08-11 (key `storage`; the string `file-storage` appears nowhere under `apps/console`).

## Reproduction

1. Boot showcase (or any host with the storage service registered) and open Studio → Developer → API Console.
2. Wait for discovery to resolve; enumerate the rendered endpoint groups.
3. Observe: no **Storage** group, on every host tried.
4. Confirm the service is really there: `GET /api/v1/discovery` reports the slot under the name `file-storage`, not `storage`.

## Source

Extracted from the QA run objectstack-ai/objectstack#7463 (framework a86db175).
